import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";

describe("ProjectName", () => {
  test("accepts a name", () => {
    expect("Apollo".length).toBe(6);
  });

  describe("parse", () => {
    test("trims whitespace", () => {
      expect(" a ".trim()).toBe("a");
    });
    test.skip("rejects emoji", () => {});
    test.todo("normalises unicode");
  });
});
